text_block_list.text:
After the race, Бива Хаяхидэ and I
head to the
training course to apply the
data she's collected
today into her
calculations.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
At the track, we find Уиннинг Тикит and
Narita
Taishin training, apparently
having been inspired
by the race to work
even harder.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Watching them run their hearts out
makes Biwa
Hayahide realize it's only a
matter of time before
she must face
them at the starting line.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
More importantly though, she must set
herself
apart to compete against her
sister. And to
achieve that, we make our
next goal the first race
in the Classic
Triple Crown tour, the Satsuki Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
